## Core contract
Default roguelite profile: the player prepares at a base, begins a run, repeatedly chooses ONE of THREE temporary upgrades, gathers loot, secures eligible resources, and eventually dies or finishes. Temporary powers reset at run end. Explicitly retained resources fund persistent facilities, specialists, new equipment families, routes, and combinations. Permanent access to an upgrade family does not automatically grant that upgrade in every run. One cohesive art direction spans every system.
